title: Inference-Time Computations for LLM Reasoning and Planning: A Benchmark and Insights

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance degradation of tree search methods (e.g., Tree of Thought) as search depth increases, and measuring the frequency at which models generate popular, memorized algorithm moves (e.g., online solutions for the Rubik's Cube task) rather than genuinely exploring the reasoning search space.
